title: Minimum Down Payment on TRAC Deficiency Arrangements (Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease)
content:
# Collections Schedule — Minimum Down Payment on a TRAC Deficiency Arrangement, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

**Schedule.** For a Kestrel payment arrangement on a TRAC deficiency of a Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease unit, the minimum down payment is $1,000 where the deficiency charges billed on the unit total $5,000 or more, $500 where they total $2,500 or more but less than $5,000, and nothing where they total less than $2,500.

**Records read.** The deficiency charges posted on the unit's own ledger, added together.

| Deficiency charges billed on the unit, in total (USD) | Minimum down payment (USD) |
|---|---|
| 5000 or more | 1000 |
| 2500 or more, but less than 5000 | 500 |
| less than 2500 | nothing |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical totals)

| Total deficiency charges billed on the unit | Minimum down payment |
|---|---|
| 5000.00 | $1,000 |
| 4999.99 | $500 |
| 2500.00 | $500 |
| 2499.99 | nothing |

A unit whose ledger carries no deficiency charge totals nothing, which is less than $2,500, so there is no minimum down payment.
